title: Spring Boot Testing & Production Handbook
summary: Quick revision notes on testing Spring Boot apps (@SpringBootTest, slice tests, MockMvc, Testcontainers) and shipping them (Actuator, logging, externalized config, packaging, Docker images).

chapters.title: Spring Boot Testing Mental Model
points: Test pyramid in Spring Boot: plain unit tests (no Spring) > slice tests (partial context) > @SpringBootTest (full context); pick the narrowest that proves the behavior
@SpringBootTest boots the full ApplicationContext; webEnvironment defaults to MOCK (no real server), RANDOM_PORT starts embedded server, DEFINED_PORT uses server.port, NONE has no web layer
spring-boot-starter-test bundles JUnit 5, AssertJ, Mockito, Hamcrest, JSONassert, JsonPath and Spring Test
Context caching: Spring reuses a context across test classes with identical config; any difference (@MockBean set, properties, profiles) builds a new one and slows the suite
@SpringBootTest finds config by searching upward from the test package for @SpringBootConfiguration; put tests in the same package tree as the main app class

chapters.title: Slice Tests and MockMvc
points: @WebMvcTest(UserController.class) loads only controllers, @ControllerAdvice, Filters, Converters and WebMvcConfigurer; services and repositories are NOT loaded
Controller dependencies must be supplied with @MockitoBean (Boot 3.4+; @MockBean deprecated before it) or the context fails with NoSuchBeanDefinitionException
MockMvc flow: mockMvc.perform(get("/users/1")).andExpect(status().isOk()).andExpect(jsonPath("$.name").value("Ann")); no real HTTP, goes through DispatcherServlet
POST with JSON: perform(post("/users").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).content(json)); forgetting contentType returns 415

@DataJpaTest loads only entities and repositories with in-memory DB, wraps each test in a rolled-back transaction, and injects TestEntityManager; add @AutoConfigureTestDatabase(replace = NONE) to use a real DB
Other slices: @JsonTest, @RestClientTest, @DataJdbcTest; Spring Security tests need spring-security-test with @WithMockUser and csrf() on state-changing requests

chapters.title: Testcontainers and Integration Tests
points: Testcontainers runs real dependencies (Postgres, Kafka, Redis) in throwaway Docker containers so tests match production; requires Docker running
Boot 3.1+ wiring: annotate a container field/bean with @ServiceConnection and the datasource properties are auto-configured, no manual URL needed

JUnit 5 setup: @Testcontainers on the class plus @Container static PostgreSQLContainer<?> db = new PostgreSQLContainer<>("postgres:16"); static field = one container shared per class, non-static = one per test
Pre-3.1 fallback: @DynamicPropertySource static void props(DynamicPropertyRegistry r) { r.add("spring.datasource.url", db::getJdbcUrl); }
@SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = RANDOM_PORT) with TestRestTemplate or WebTestClient for end-to-end tests; pin image tags, never use latest
Replace H2 with Testcontainers for @DataJpaTest when SQL dialect, JSON columns or migrations (Flyway) matter

chapters.title: Actuator, Logging and Externalized Config
points: Actuator: add spring-boot-starter-actuator; by default only /actuator/health is exposed over HTTP; expose more with management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info,metrics,prometheus
Key endpoints: /health (liveness/readiness groups), /info, /metrics/{name}, /env, /loggers (change log level at runtime via POST), /heapdump, /threaddump; never expose /env or /heapdump publicly
Kubernetes probes: /actuator/health/liveness and /actuator/health/readiness; separate management.server.port keeps them off the public port
Logging: Logback is the default via SLF4J; set logging.level.com.acme=DEBUG, logging.file.name=app.log, logging.pattern.console; prefer SLF4J logger with {} placeholders over string concatenation
Config precedence (high to low): command-line args > SPRING_APPLICATION_JSON > OS env vars > application-{profile}.yml > application.yml > @PropertySource > defaults

Env var relaxed binding: SERVER_PORT maps to server.port, MY_APP_DB_URL to my.app.db-url; activate profiles with spring.profiles.active=prod; bind typed config with @ConfigurationProperties over scattered @Value
Never commit secrets to application.yml; inject through env vars or a secret store, and use spring.config.import for external files

chapters.title: Packaging and Docker Images
points: ./mvnw package or ./gradlew bootJar produces an executable fat JAR with nested dependencies, run with java -jar app.jar; war packaging is only for external servlet containers

Layered JAR (default since Boot 2.4) splits dependencies, spring-boot-loader, snapshot-dependencies, application; extract with java -Djarmode=tools -jar app.jar extract --layers so unchanged dependency layers stay cached in Docker
Buildpacks, no Dockerfile needed: ./mvnw spring-boot:build-image (or bootBuildImage) builds an OCI image with a JRE, memory calculator and non-root user

Dockerfile multi-stage: build stage with JDK extracts layers, runtime stage uses a JRE image, COPY layers in order dependencies first and application last, run as non-root, ENTRYPOINT ["java","-jar","app.jar"]
Container tuning: JVM is container-aware, set -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75 instead of a fixed -Xmx; pass config via env vars and expose the port; add graceful shutdown with server.shutdown=graceful
Common mistakes: copying the whole fat JAR as one layer (slow rebuilds), running as root, using a full JDK in the runtime image, baking secrets into the image, using latest as the base tag

chapters.title: Spring Boot Testing and Production Cheat Sheet
points: Test choice: pure unit test first; @WebMvcTest for controllers (+@MockitoBean); @DataJpaTest for repositories; @SpringBootTest(RANDOM_PORT) + Testcontainers for end-to-end
Test gotchas: 415 means missing contentType; NoSuchBeanDefinitionException in a slice means a missing mock; each distinct @MockBean/property set creates a new cached context
Actuator and logging commands: management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info,prometheus; POST /actuator/loggers/com.acme with {"configuredLevel":"DEBUG"}; logging.level.root=INFO
Config rule of thumb: command line > env vars > profile file > application.yml; SERVER_PORT overrides server.port; secrets only via env or secret store
Ship it: ./mvnw package -> java -jar app.jar; ./mvnw spring-boot:build-image for no-Dockerfile images; layered multi-stage Dockerfile with a JRE runtime, non-root user and MaxRAMPercentage=75
